0022600165.text: The Pelicans (2-4, 11th in the West, 5th in the Southwest and 4 games back) come to Memphis on a two-game winning streak, while the unbeaten Grizzlies (6-0, first in the West and Southwest) have won six straight. New Orleans is without Dejounte Murray (personal), Jordan Poole (ankle sprain) and Yves Missi (knee bruise), and Memphis is without Quinten Post (ankle) and Scotty Pippen Jr. (back soreness). The teams have not met yet this season, but they split their 2025-26 series 2-2, and the Pelicans won the last meeting 114-106 in New Orleans on January 30, 2026.
